articles.title: Tommy John, Dodgers pitcher and medical pioneer, dies at 83
articles.summary: The article highlights "Tommy John surgery" as a recognized medical procedure documented in textbooks. It's presented alongside other established surgical techniques like Belsey fundoplication, Heineke-Mikulicz pyloroplasty, and Keller's excision arthroplasty. This emphasizes its importance and acceptance within the medical community as a standard surgical practice, indicating its significance in healthcare advancements.

articles.title: Tommy John, Yankees great who had surgery named after him, dead at 83
articles.summary: Tommy John, the pioneering baseball pitcher, has died at 83. He gained lasting fame as the first player to undergo the revolutionary elbow surgery now named after him. Performed in 1974, this procedure extended his career and subsequently transformed sports medicine, enabling countless athletes to recover from injuries and continue their professional journeys.

articles.title: Villarreal battle back to earn draw at promoted Racing
articles.summary: In their opening La Liga clash, Villarreal dramatically snatched a 2-2 draw against promoted side Racing Santander. After the hosts took an early lead, Villarreal scored two crucial goals in just over a minute to level the score. This thrilling start to the Spanish top-flight football season showcased a strong comeback performance, highlighting the competitive nature of international sports.

articles.title: SC Delhi Dominates Raengdai To Reach Durand Cup Semis

This triumph ensures their advancement in the prestigious Durand Cup football tournament. Such sporting success highlights the importance of teamwork, strategy, and perseverance, key attributes for any aspiring defence personnel.

articles.title: Shera Energy eyes 25-30% revenue growth in FY27; bets on new products, capacity expansion
articles.summary: Jaipur-based Shera Energy is targeting an ambitious 25-30% revenue growth in the current financial year. This expansion will be driven by increased production capacity and the introduction of new value-added products, primarily catering to the power and related sectors. This move highlights a domestic company's commitment to industrial growth and its contribution to national infrastructure development and economic progress.
